name: ux1a-train
js: for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !v.rail.active; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const p=document.getElementById('panel');p.classList.remove('hidden');p.scrollTop=0;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const ids=['preset','altitude','wing-pos','high-lift','voyage-on','hdg','nav-dest','turn-left','turn-right','debug-arrive'];const t=ids.map(id=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);return id+(e.disabled?'[禁]':'')+'='+e.title}).join(' | ');const alt=document.querySelector('[data-alt]');const nav=document.querySelector('[data-nav]');const h=document.getElementById('vehicle-hint');return JSON.stringify({railActive:v.rail.active,titles:t,alt:alt.disabled+':'+alt.title,nav:nav.disabled+':'+nav.title,vehicleHint:h?(h.hidden?'(hidden)':h.textContent):'(无)'})

name: ux1a-plane-after-train
js: for (let i = 0; i < 300 && v.rail.active; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const ids=['preset','altitude','wing-pos','high-lift','voyage-on','hdg','nav-dest','turn-left','turn-right','debug-arrive'];const t=ids.map(id=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);return id+(e.disabled?'[禁]':'')+'='+e.title}).join(' | ');const alt=document.querySelector('[data-alt]');const h=document.getElementById('vehicle-hint');return JSON.stringify({railActive:v.rail.active,titles:t,alt:alt.disabled+':'+alt.title,vehicleHint:h?(h.hidden?'(hidden)':h.textContent):'(无)'})

name: ux1a-keys
js: const p=document.getElementById('panel');p.classList.remove('hidden');const res={};const key=(el,k,o={})=>el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',Object.assign({key:k,bubbles:true,cancelable:true},o)));const date=document.getElementById('date');date.focus();key(date,'h');res.hInDate=p.classList.contains('hidden')?'隐藏了(错)':'未隐藏(对)';key(date,'b');res.bInDate=v.director.backdrop?'进背景板(错)':'未进(对)';const seat=document.getElementById('seat');seat.focus();key(seat,'m');res.mInSelect=v.audio.enabled?'开了声音(错)':'未开(对)';key(seat,'n');res.nInSelect=v.minimap.enabled?'开了小地图(错)':'未开(对)';key(seat,'h');res.hInSelect=p.classList.contains('hidden')?'隐藏了(错)':'未隐藏(对)';seat.blur();key(document.body,'h',{ctrlKey:true});res.ctrlH=p.classList.contains('hidden')?'隐藏了(错)':'未隐藏(对)';key(document.body,'h');res.hOnBody=p.classList.contains('hidden')?'隐藏了(对)':'未隐藏(错)';key(document.body,'h');const ws=document.getElementById('weather');ws.focus();ws.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true}));ws.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));res.selectBlurAfterPointer=document.activeElement===ws?'仍聚焦(错)':'已还焦点(对)';const vp=document.getElementById('view-preset');vp.focus();vp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));res.selectKeepFocusKeyboard=document.activeElement===vp?'键盘操作保持焦点(对)':'失焦';vp.blur();const nb=document.querySelector('[data-rate]');nb.focus();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));res.focusRing=getComputedStyle(nb).outlineStyle+' '+getComputedStyle(nb).outlineColor+' '+getComputedStyle(nb).outlineWidth;res.panelAria=p.getAttribute('aria-label');return JSON.stringify(res)
